lines.text: ...So you’ve come!\nI had a vision of your arrival.
I have had psychic powers since I was a child.\c\nIt started when I carelessly threw a spoon aside\nand it bent itself into an unnatural shape...
I dislike battling, but if you wish to...
Then I will show you my power!
Your victory has earned you a Marsh Badge.
You got a [VAR COLOR(0006)]Marsh Badge[VAR COLOR(0000)] from Sabrina!

A Marsh Badge raises the level of Pokémon
that will obey you to Lv. [VAR NUM2(0004)], for Pokémon that
you have received from another Trainer.\c
And wait...
Please take this TM with you.
You got [VAR ITEM2(0001)] [VAR COLOR(0006)][VAR MOVE(0002)][VAR COLOR(0000)] from Sabrina!
TM33 is Calm Mind.\c\nIt makes a Pokémon concentrate to boost both\nits Sp. Atk and Sp. Def in battle.

Psychic power isn’t something that only a few
people have.\c
Everyone has psychic power.
People just don’t realize it.
